btn_install.en: Install the app if you don't have it

hint_1.so: Marka aad iskaan gareyso QR-ka ku yaal shaashadda RayTok ee taleefanka kale, halkan ayaad imanaysaa. Haddii abka la rakibay isla markiiba wuu furmayaa; haddii kale ku rakib badhanka kore kadibna mar kale iskaan garee QR-ka.
hint_1.en: Scanning the QR on the other phone's RayTok screen brings you here. If the app is installed it opens right away; if not, install it with the button above and scan the QR again.

hint_2.so: Labada taleefan waa inay ku jiraan isla Wi-Fi (ama hotspot-ka midkood). Internet looma baahna.
hint_2.en: Both phones must be on the same Wi-Fi (or one phone's hotspot). No internet needed.

hint_3.so: Macluumaadka isku xirka ee ku yaal baarka cinwaanka waa cinwaanka gudaha ee taleefankaas iyo koodh xaqiijin ah oo hal mar la isticmaalo. Macno ma laha Wi-Fi-gaas dibaddiisa, wuxuuna joojiyaa shaqada isla marka martigeliyuhu xiro shaashadda.
hint_3.en: The connection info in the address bar is that phone's local address and a one-time verification code. It means nothing unless you're on the same Wi-Fi, and it stops working as soon as the host closes the screen.

msg_no_info.so: Xiriirkan ma laha macluumaad isku xir. Fadlan mar kale iskaan garee QR-ka shaashadda kale.
msg_no_info.en: This link has no connection info. Please scan the QR on the other screen again.

msg_android.so: Haddii abka la rakibay isla markiiba wuu furmayaa. Haddii kale taabo badhanka hoose.
msg_android.en: If the app is installed it will open right away. If not, tap the button below.

msg_ios.so: Xiriirkan wuxuu u yahay abka RayTok ee Android. Ab iPhone ah weli ma jiro.
msg_ios.en: This link is for the Android RayTok app. There is no iPhone app yet.
